items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 14:1
items.html: (To the question) They are the aspect of the illumination of the head from above downward, as above in Answer 143. And there is no difference in this between face to face and back to back, for in both the lower one does not receive them in the place of the head, but by the bowing of the head down to the place of the HGT, and the lower one takes them from the place of the HGT. (Item 12).
